name: dsh-crew
description: The crew for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a spine session on the crew-spine preset runs ossify's run-spine --external-executor, dispatching each work item to a configured subagent_implementer child, verifying it with a subagent_verifier child, computing ossify's result record from git and handing the round back. ossify state is the single authority; this plugin adds nothing to its contract. Two prose skills (dsh-executor, dsh-brief) and a presets reference the operator copies into the dsh home. No lib, no state, no commands.

interface.shortDescription: Run ossify spines inside DeepSeek Harness
interface.longDescription: A spine session in DeepSeek Harness runs ossify's run-spine --external-executor, dispatching each work item to a configured implementer child tool and verifying it with a configured verifier child tool. ossify state stays the single authority; the plugin ships prose skills only and adds nothing to ossify's contract.
